result.title: Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization
result.summary: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RADPO，一种无模型的扩散策略在线优化方法：用折扣首达可达性价值估计未来成本事件风险，并结合累积成本预算的对偶乘子调整奖励塑形强度，在连续控制安全任务上改善奖励—成本权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「首达可达性价值 + 预算反馈」的停止/风险决策表述，可能启发 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本-收益权衡与停止决策评价，可供核查。
